## Installation

Build the verified repository revision from source:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/aspose-slides-foss/Aspose.Slides-FOSS-for-Cpp.git
cd Aspose.Slides-FOSS-for-Cpp
git checkout 25adb25c8796f06d9b89cd5f8093e490091195ef
mvn clean install
```

This path requires JDK unknown+ and Maven. The source build and the minimal example
below were verified together at revision `25adb25c8796f06d9b89cd5f8093e490091195ef`.
